title: Architecture Patterns & Principles
intro: Software architecture interview questions cover the higher-level patterns senior interviews probe — layered vs hexagonal vs clean architecture, DDD (entities, aggregates, bounded contexts, ubiquitous language), CQRS and event sourcing, the SOLID principles applied at the system level, modular monolith vs microservices, and the architectural trade-offs interviewers love to discuss (consistency vs availability, cohesion vs coupling). Use this page for staff/principal-level interviews where the question is rarely "how would you implement X" and more often "how would you decompose Y".
